<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>5 分钟极速开户教程｜BIT 证券美股开户图文指南</title>
<meta name="description" content="BIT 证券美股开户全流程图文教程：下载 App、注册、按真实情况完成 KYC 开户认证；审核进度与开户结果以 App 通知为准。">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500&family=Noto+Sans+SC:wght@400;500;700&display=swap">
<style>
/* ============================================================
   教程页 · Coinbase editorial（与主页同一设计系统 v9）
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --blue:#0052ff; --blue-d:#4a80ff;
  --ink:#0a0b0d; --body:#5b616e; --muted:#7c828a;
  --hl:#dee1e6; --hl-soft:#eef0f3; --canvas:#fff; --soft:#f7f7f7;
  --dark:#0a0b0d; --dark-el:#16181c; --ond:#fff; --ond-soft:#a8acb3;
  --up:#05b169;
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  background:var(--canvas);color:var(--body);
  font-family:'Noto Sans SC',-apple-system,'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;
  font-size:15px;line-height:1.72;overflow-x:hidden;
}
.wrap{max-width:620px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
a{color:var(--blue);text-decoration:none}
.band-soft{background:var(--soft)}
.band-white{background:var(--canvas)}

/* ---------- 暗色 hero ---------- */
.hero{background:var(--dark);color:var(--ond-soft);padding:14px 0 26px}
.back{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ond-soft);padding:10px 0 0}
h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--blue-d)}
h1{font-family:'Inter Tight','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;font-size:29px;line-height:1.35;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--ond);margin:14px 0 10px;text-wrap:balance}
.lede{font-size:13px;color:var(--ond-soft);margin-bottom:20px;max-width:38em}
.invite{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;
  background:var(--dark-el);border:none;border-radius:20px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:0;
}
.invite .l{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-bottom:2px}
.invite .code{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:27px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ond);letter-spacing:.06em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.invite button{
  background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:100px;
  padding:11px 24px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;flex:none;
}

/* ---------- 步骤区 ---------- */
.band{padding:8px 0}
.band .wrap{padding-top:34px;padding-bottom:38px}
.step-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:0 0 4px}
.step-h .n{
  flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--ink);color:#fff;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-family:'Inter Tight',sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;
}
.step-h h2{font-family:'Inter Tight','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;font-size:22px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--ink)}
.step-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0 16px;padding-left:42px}
.card{background:var(--soft);border:none;border-radius:20px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:12px}
.band-soft .card{background:var(--canvas)}

/* 下载渠道 */
.dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
.dl a{
  display:block;background:var(--soft);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:20px;padding:18px;color:var(--ink);
  cursor:pointer;transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1),box-shadow .22s,border-color .22s,background .22s;
}
.dl a:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);background:#fff;border-color:rgba(0,82,255,.32);box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(16,24,40,.18),0 4px 10px -6px rgba(0,82,255,.15)}
.dl a:active{transform:translateY(-1px) scale(.985)}
.dl .d-t{font-family:'Inter Tight','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:3px;color:var(--blue);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
.dl .d-t::after{
  content:"↓";flex:none;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(0,82,255,.1);color:var(--blue);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;
  transition:transform .22s,background .22s,color .22s;
}
.dl a:hover .d-t::after{transform:translateY(2px);background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.dl a,.dl .d-t::after{transition:none}}
.dl .d-d{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.55}
.dl a.ios,.dl a.gp,.dl a.tf{background:var(--soft);border:none}
.dl a.apk{background:var(--soft);border:none;display:block}
.dl a.apk .d-t{color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:3px}
.dl a.ios .d-t,.dl a.gp .d-t,.dl a.tf .d-t{color:var(--blue)}

/* 桌面版下载二维码 */
.dlqr{display:none}
.s1-head{display:block}
@media(min-width:900px){
  .s1-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:32px;margin-bottom:16px}
  .s1-left{flex:1}
  .s1-head .step-sub{margin-bottom:0}
  .dlqr{display:block;flex:none;width:140px;text-align:center;margin-top:2px}
  .dlqr img{width:120px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--hl);border-radius:12px;padding:5px;display:block;margin:0 auto 8px}
  .dlqr span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;display:block}
}

/* 商店支持地区 */
.notice{background:var(--soft);border:none;border-radius:20px;padding:18px 20px;font-size:13px;color:var(--body);line-height:1.85;margin-bottom:0}
.notice b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.rbtn{
  display:inline-block;background:none;color:var(--blue);
  border:1px solid var(--hl);border-radius:100px;
  padding:8px 20px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;margin-top:10px;font-family:inherit;
}
.rlist{display:none;margin-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--hl);padding-top:12px}
.rlist.open{display:block}
.rl-sum{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--body);margin-bottom:10px}
.rl-sum b{color:var(--ink);font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace}
.rgroup{margin-bottom:12px}
.rg-t{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:5px}
.rg-row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:12px;color:var(--body);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:5px}
.rg-tag{flex:none;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;border-radius:100px;padding:2px 9px;margin-top:3px;white-space:nowrap;border:none}
.t-both{background:rgba(5,177,105,.1);color:#048253}
.t-ios{background:rgba(0,82,255,.08);color:var(--blue)}
.t-gp{background:var(--hl-soft);color:var(--body)}

/* 流程列表 */
.flow{list-style:none}
.flow li{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:7px 0;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--body)}
.flow li .ar{flex:none;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.flow li b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}

.flow li.warn span,.flow li.warn b,.flow li.warn .ar{color:#cf202f}
.flow li.warn span{font-weight:600}

/* 填表小抄 */
.tips{list-style:none}
.tips li{display:flex;gap:9px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:none;font-size:14px;color:var(--body)}
.tips li::before{content:"✓";flex:none;color:var(--blue);font-weight:700}
.tips li b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.kgroup{padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hl-soft)}
.kgroup:last-child{border-bottom:none;padding-bottom:4px}
.kgroup .tips li{padding:3px 0}
.kgroup .shots{margin-top:10px}
.kgroup .shot-solo{margin:10px auto 2px}

/* 配图 */
.shot-solo{max-width:330px;margin:12px auto 4px}
.shot-solo img{width:100%;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid var(--hl);display:block}
.shot-cap{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin-top:7px;line-height:1.55}
.shot-cap b{color:var(--ink)}
.shots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:12px}
.shots .shot{background:var(--soft);border:none;border-radius:16px;padding:9px}
.band-soft .shots .shot,.card .shots .shot{background:var(--canvas)}
.shots img{width:100%;border-radius:10px;display:block}
.shots .shot-cap{margin-top:8px}

/* 完成区：渐变蓝 */
.done{
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#eaf1ff 0%,#f2f6ff 46%,#e3edff 100%);
  border:none;border-radius:28px;padding:26px 22px;margin-top:0;
}
.done .d-t{font-family:'Inter Tight','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;font-size:23px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:10px}
.done p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--body);line-height:1.85}
.done p b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}

/* 人工咨询 */
.help{margin-top:26px;text-align:center}
.help p{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:14px}
.help .qr{display:block;width:172px;margin:0 auto 14px;background:#fff;padding:10px;border-radius:20px}
.help .qr img{width:100%;display:block;border-radius:10px}
.help a.tg{
  display:inline-block;background:var(--blue);border:none;
  color:#fff;border-radius:100px;padding:12px 30px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;
}

.foot{padding:26px 0 20px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.85;border-top:1px solid var(--hl);margin-top:8px}
.foot p{margin-bottom:8px}

/* ============ Web 端适配 ============ */
@media(min-width:900px){
  body{font-size:16px}
  .hero{padding:22px 0 44px}
  .hero .wrap{max-width:1120px;padding:0 48px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 420px;column-gap:80px;align-items:end}
  .back{grid-column:1/-1}
  h1{font-size:44px;margin:22px 0 14px}
  .lede{font-size:14px;margin-bottom:0;align-self:end}
  .invite{grid-column:2;grid-row:2/4;align-self:end;padding:22px 24px}
  .invite .code{font-size:32px}
  .band .wrap{max-width:860px;padding:0 48px 56px;padding-top:52px}
  .step-h h2{font-size:28px}
  .step-h .n{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:15px}
  .step-sub{font-size:14px;padding-left:46px}
  .dl{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px}
  .dl a{padding:22px 20px}
  .card{padding:26px 30px;border-radius:24px}
  .notice{padding:24px 30px;border-radius:24px;font-size:14px}
  .shots{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
  .shot-solo{max-width:360px}
  .done{padding:36px 40px}
  .done .d-t{font-size:24px}
  .help a.tg{font-size:15px;padding:13px 36px}
  .foot{max-width:860px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;padding-left:48px;padding-right:48px}
}
</style>
</head>

<div class="band band-white"><div class="wrap">
<!-- ============ Step 3 ============ -->
  <div class="step-h"><span class="n">3</span><h2>完成美股开户认证（KYC）</h2></div>

  <div class="card">
